note: Rewritten from the species description of Sands (1972); the original is in English, the genus lacks a soldier caste, and only alates and workers are described; measurement tables, figure numbers, type specimens and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: It differs from the closely related A. comis, A. concilians and A. eumenus in the weakly inflated postclypeus and the longer apical tooth of the mandibles of the alate. The worker is larger than in A. comis and A. eumenus, and the mandibular proportions also differ; in A. concilians the fore tibia is less inflated and the apical tooth shorter. The worker abdomen of A. amicus is not incised.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; pilosity concolorous, very fine, filiform and sparse. Postclypeus very weakly inflated, Pcl/W 0.24, Pcl/Ri 2.10. Apical tooth of the mandibles rather long, La/Li 0.69, Ra/Ri 0.97; the subsidiary tooth of the left mandible is, in surface view, just separate from the molar prominence, composite ratio 14.45; the tip of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible lies slightly behind the line from the apical to the second marginal tooth, but its anterior margin is equal in length to that of the second marginal tooth, composite ratio 20.99. Fore tibia moderately inflated, Ti/Ty 3.86; third apical spur distinct. Mesenteron-proctodeum junction oblique, lying to the right of the Malpighian nodule; enteric valve seating lateral in the unopened abdomen, the two lobes moderately developed, connected to the second pouch through the proctodeum by a long neck; the membranous wall of the valve bears sparse microspines outside the inner cushions.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown, not darker above the ocellus; fontanelle small, about one-third the size of the ocellus, subcircular, with a small central depression, pale yellowish brown; central spot subcircular, flat or slightly raised, slightly smaller than the fontanelle, yellowish brown; postclypeus yellowish brown, labrum yellow; frontal spot flat, almost effaced, weakly crescent-shaped, yellowish brown; antennae yellow. Pronotum and meso- and metanotum yellowish brown, the transverse sutures present but weak; femora yellow, tibiae pale yellow, tarsi yellowish white. Abdominal tergites yellowish brown, sternites and dorsal and ventral spiracles pale yellowish brown, cerci pale yellow. Posterior margin of the head capsule evenly rounded; ocellus moderate in size, separated from the compound eye by half its minimum diameter or slightly more; postclypeus moderately inflated, Pcl/W 0.25–0.26, Pcl/Ra 1.93–2.00, posterior margin evenly rounded, median suture very weak. Apical tooth of the mandibles rather long, La/Li 0.71–0.79, Ra/Ri 1.04–1.05; the proximal end of the subsidiary tooth of the left mandible is, in surface view, just separate from the molar prominence, composite ratio 11.61–13.20; the tips of the apical and marginal teeth of the right mandible lie on the same line, the anterior margins of the marginal teeth about equal. Head pilosity yellow, slightly uneven, approaching a coarse felt with erect setae. Third apical spur of the fore tibia distinct.
